specs.By Material: PEEK Solid block , Titanium Coated PEEK

description: The Vertu Ti-Bond Zero-profile Stand-alone ACDF spacer and screw implant by Spinal Elements is a PEEK interbody spacer with Ti-Bond porous titanium coating. The Ti-Bond allows for increased bony adhesion early in the fusion process and increased surface topography allowing for bony ingrowth. The spacer has 0-profile integrated screw fixation with lag screw compression with automatic locking.
features: PEEK interbody spacer with Ti-Bond porous titanium coating
Zero-profile integrated screw fixation for stand-alone constructs.
